method: Matched each built cue's normalized word sequence against the chronological forced-aligned word ledger, reversing display-only AI, TCC and Sully.ai substitutions. Measured cue start and end against first and last covered words. Median is below the required 150ms; the maximum includes deliberate reading holds.
scope: Built caption timing evidence, not an independent acoustic alignment or proof of rendered visibility. Final frame inspection and caption_render_check remain required.
